🔮 AstroTrader Pro™ — Today’s sky — November 21, 2026

Moon, in Aries, holds an opposition to Venus, at home in Libra. Two tempers that rarely agree, briefly aligned: what you hold is weighed against what it cost to hold it.

Easier — Seeing the real cost of an arrangement you had stopped examining.
Harder — Defending a position you no longer hold for reasons you no longer have.
Backdrop — Saturn and Uranus hold a month-long sextile underneath all of it.

♈ ARIES
Mars governs you, untitled in Leo. Moon is inside your sign, at arm’s length. Cardinal fire: the start and the settlement coincide. Two weeks of it, long enough to have stopped noticing.

♉ TAURUS
Venus, your ruler, is on home ground in Libra. Mercury opposes you from Scorpio, and the account has two columns. Fixed earth pays to hold on. It has held four weeks without changing its terms.

♊ GEMINI
Mercury, your ruler, crosses Scorpio with no title of its own. Venus trines you from Libra, meeting no resistance. Air bends, and bending costs nothing here. The conjunction of two weeks ago is off it now.

♋ CANCER
Moon governs you from Aries, borrowed ground, taken as it comes. Venus squares you from Libra: wanting and cost refuse to agree. Cardinal water: the beginning has a price on it. Sun let go of it a week ago.

♌ LEO
Sun rules you from Scorpio, untitled. Moon in Aries sides with you before you have argued. Fixed fire: nothing needs letting go of today. Two weeks in, and the shape of it is no longer a surprise.

♍ VIRGO
Mercury, your ruler, crosses Scorpio untitled. Sun sextiles you from Scorpio: a door left ajar. Earth adapts, and adapting costs nothing here. Mercury went direct two weeks ago; the re-reading is over.

♎ LIBRA
Venus rules you from its own Libra. Moon faces you from Aries: your measure comes back as someone else’s. Cardinal air meets a bill. Since Venus crossed out of Scorpio, the question has changed.

♏ SCORPIO
Mars rules you from Leo, untitled. Mercury crosses your sign, and nothing stays general. Fixed water: the holding and the held stop differing. The hold Moon had two weeks ago is not there any more.

♐ SAGITTARIUS
Jupiter rules you from Leo, where nothing is owed to it. From Aries, Moon concedes the point early. Mutable fire: two answers, neither expensive. It has stood four weeks; by now the cost is known.

♑ CAPRICORN
Saturn rules you from Aries, without leverage of its own. From Aries, Moon cuts across the appetite. Earth moves first and pays first. The same angle for four weeks, and the price has stopped moving.

♒ AQUARIUS
Saturn, your ruler, falls in Aries. From Aries, Moon hands you an opening. Air keeps its grip, and the grip costs nothing. The conjunction to Moon that held four weeks ago has let go.

♓ PISCES
Jupiter, your ruler, crosses Leo untitled. Sun trines you from Scorpio, meeting no resistance. Water that changes shape, and the shape fits. Two weeks ago Jupiter was still held by Moon; that is finished.
